info.text:
Your taxes don't pay for the Federal Reserve.
Congress doesn't fund it. Its income comes mainly from interest on the bonds it holds, plus fees for services to banks.
After costs, it sends leftover profit to the Treasury: over $100 billion in 2021.
In 2025 it earned $155.3 billion in interest but paid out $167.4 billion. Losses are booked as a deferred asset, about $233 billion as of Sept 30, 2026, repaid from future profits before most remittances resume.
Sources: Federal Reserve (2021 results, 2025 financial statements, H.4.1 Oct 1, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
